sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract">stateCHANGESTO200^ORstate=999^EQ<item display_value="Closed Complete" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="false" value="200"/><item display_value="Canceled" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="true" value="999"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Calculate and Generate Invoice Total</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

	// Add your code here
	var total_amount =current.getValue('total_equipment_cost');

	//fees/substractions - tbi

	//deductions
	var startDate = new GlideDateTime(current.getValue('start_date'));
    var endDate = new GlideDateTime(current.getValue('end_date'));
    
    var duration = GlideDateTime.subtract(startDate, endDate);
    var actualDays = duration.getRoundedDayPart();

	if (actualDays < 1) {
        actualDays = 1; //billing for at least 1 day if the contract is terminated immediately
    }

	var finalAmountDeductions = 0;
	var finalAmount = 0;

	if (current.getValue('state') == '999') {
        
        var totalDailyRate = 0;
		var itemGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract_item');
        itemGr.addQuery('contract', current.getUniqueValue());
        itemGr.query();
        
        while (itemGr.next()) {
            totalDailyRate += parseFloat(itemGr.getValue('locked_daily_rate')) || 0;
        }
        
        finalAmount = actualDays * totalDailyRate;
		finalAmountDeductions = total_amount - finalAmount;
        
    } else {
        //if not terminated early, use the standard expected total
		finalAmountDeductions = 0;
        finalAmount = current.getValue('total_equipment_cost');
    }

	//create Invoice record
	var grInvoice = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_invoice');

	grInvoice.initialize();
	grInvoice.contract = current.getUniqueValue();
	grInvoice.client=current.getValue('client');
	grInvoice.deductions = finalAmountDeductions;
	grInvoice.base_price = total_amount;
	grInvoice.total_amount = finalAmount;

	grInvoice.insert();


})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-25 21:43:20</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a2f8e369c367831451347405e401318d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Calculate and Generate Invoice Total</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_a2f8e369c367831451347405e401318d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 16:50:47</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=a2f8e369c367831451347405e401318d"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_1b8dc0a4c3d30b5051347405e4013113
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2133764_peak_e_0.EquipmentAvailability</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>EquipmentAvailability</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var EquipmentAvailability = Class.create();
EquipmentAvailability.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    checkDates: function() {
        var catItemId = this.getParameter('sysparm_cat_item');
        var startDate = this.getParameter('sysparm_startDate');
        var endDate = this.getParameter('sysparm_endDate');

        var startGD = new GlideDate();
        startGD.setDisplayValue(startDate);
        var sysStartDate = startGD.getValue();

        var endGD = new GlideDate();
        endGD.setDisplayValue(endDate);
        var sysEndDate = endGD.getValue();

        var overlaps = [];
        var equipId = '';

        var catItemGr = new GlideRecord('sc_cat_item');
        if (catItemGr.get(catItemId)) {
            equipId = catItemGr.getValue('u_equipment');
        }

        gs.info("DYNAMIC EQUIPMENT ID FOUND: " + equipId);

        //abort if no equipment is tied to this item
        if (!equipId) {
            return JSON.stringify(overlaps);
        }

        //query the Contract Item table
        var grItems = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract_item');

        //find items matching the requested equipment
        grItems.addQuery('equipment', equipId);

        //dot-walk to the parent contract to check the dates
		// !! only the actice contracts
		grItems.addQuery('contract.state', '130');
        grItems.addQuery('contract.start_date', '<=', sysEndDate);
        grItems.addQuery('contract.end_date', '>=', sysStartDate);
        grItems.query();

        gs.info("Records found: " + grItems.getRowCount());

        while (grItems.next()) {
            overlaps.push({
                //dot-walk to get the display values from the parent contract
                start: grItems.getElement('contract.start_date').getDisplayValue(),
                end: grItems.getElement('contract.end_date').getDisplayValue()
            });
        }

        return JSON.stringify(overlaps);
    },

    type: 'EquipmentAvailability'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-09 17:05:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>1b8dc0a4c3d30b5051347405e4013113</sys_id><sys_mod_count>19</sys_mod_count><sys_name>EquipmentAvailability</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_1b8dc0a4c3d30b5051347405e4013113</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 17:12:49</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>servicenow</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $timeout, $window, snAnalytics) {
    /* widget controller */

    var c = this;
    $scope.isLoading = false;

    $scope.card_size = c.data.card_size;
    $scope.card_type = c.data.card_type;

    $scope.handleCardFocus = function(event) {
        var $target = $(event.target);
        var $titleEl = $target.find('.text-ellipsis[data-toggle="tooltip"]').first();
        if ($titleEl.length)
            $titleEl.tooltip("show");
    };

    $scope.handleCardBlur = function(event) {
        var $target = $(event.target);
        var $titleEl = $target.find('.text-ellipsis[data-toggle="tooltip"]').first();
        if ($titleEl.length)
            $titleEl.tooltip("hide");
    };

    $scope.clicked = function(item) {
        if (item.type == 'guided_help') {
            c.server.get({
                "action": "openGuidedhelp",
                "guidedHelpId": item.guided_help
            }).then(function(resp) {
                $timeout(function() {
                    $window.open(resp.data.guidedHelpResponse.url, '_self');
                }, raiseAppseeEvent(resp.data.guidedHelpResponse));
            });
        }
    };

    $scope.getCustomColor = function(styleClassFor) {
        var cssCustomClass = "";

        var supportedColors = {
            "Primary": "primary-color",
            "Dark": "dark-color",
            "Light": "light-color",
            "Accent": "accent-color",
            "Hexcode": ""
        };

        var darkColors = ['Primary', 'Dark', 'Accent'];

        switch (styleClassFor) {
            case 'background':
                cssCustomClass = (c.data.background_color) ? supportedColors[c.data.background_color] : '';
                break;
            case 'icon_overlay':
                cssCustomClass = supportedColors[c.data.icon_background_color];
                break;
            case 'text':
                if (c.data.text_color === 'false') {
                    cssCustomClass = 'text-color-black';
                    if (c.data.text_alignment === 'Default') {
                        if (darkColors.includes(c.data.background_color)) {
                            cssCustomClass = 'text-color-white';
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (c.data.show_background === 'false' && c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                            if (darkColors.includes(c.data.background_color)) {
                                cssCustomClass = 'text-color-white';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
        return cssCustomClass;
    };

    $scope.getStyle = function(item, styleRequiredFor) {
        var styleObj = {};
        switch (styleRequiredFor) {
            case 'background':
                if (c.data.show_background === 'true' && c.data.card_type === 'Thumbnail' && c.data.text_alignment === 'Center' && item.bg_image && item.bg_image.length != 0) {
                    styleObj['background-image'] = 'url(' + item.bg_image + ')';
                }
                if (c.data.background_color === 'Hexcode') {
                    styleObj['background-color'] = c.data.background_hexcode;
                }
                if (item.type == 'guided_help') {
                    styleObj['cursor'] = 'pointer';
                }
                break;
            case 'icon_overlay':
                if (c.data.icon_background_color === 'true') {
                    styleObj['background-color'] = c.data.icon_background_hexcode;
                }
                break;
            case 'text_overlay':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'true') {
                    styleObj['background-color'] = hexToRGB(c.data.text_overlay_hexcode, '0.7');
                }
                break;
            case 'text':
                if (c.data.text_color === 'true') {
                    styleObj['color'] = c.data.text_color_hexcode;
                }
                break;
        }
        return styleObj;
    };

    $scope.getEvaluatedIconContainer = function(item) {
        switch (c.data.card_size) {
            case 'card-small':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                    return 'icon-container--no-image-color';
                } else {
                    return 'icon-container--background-small';
                }
                break;
            case 'card-medium':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                    if ((c.data.show_icon === 'true' && item.icon.length == 0) || c.data.show_icon === 'false') {
                        return 'icon-container--no-image-color';
                    } else {
                        return 'icon-container--background-medium';
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    $scope.getEvaluatedContentContainer = function(item) {
        switch (c.data.card_size) {
            case 'card-small':
                return 'content-container--no-image-color';
            case 'card-medium':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                    if (c.data.show_icon === 'true' && item.icon.length != 0) {
                        return 'content-container--content-start';
                    } else {
                        return 'content-container--no-image-color';
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
    };

    $scope.getTextEllipsisClassForIE = function(item) {
        var cssClassName = "text-ellipsis-";
        if (c.data.card_size === 'card-medium') {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "medium";
        } else {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "small";
        }
        if (c.data.show_icon === 'true' && item.icon && item.icon.length != 0) {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "-icon";
        } else {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "-no-icon";
        }
        return cssClassName;
    };

    $(window).resize(handleToolTip);
    $scope.$evalAsync(handleToolTip);

    function handleToolTip() {
        var isIE = window.navigator.userAgent.indexOf('Trident/') !== -1;
        $timeout(function() {
            $(".card-thumbnail-align-center, .card-thumbnail-align-left, .card-simple").each(function(index) {
                var hideToolTip = false;
                var span = $(this).find(".card-title");
                if (isIE) {
                    if (span && span[0] && span.width() >= span[0].scrollWidth) {
                        hideToolTip = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (span && span[0] && span.height() >= span[0].scrollHeight) {
                        hideToolTip = true;
                    }
                }
                if (hideToolTip) {
                    $(this).tooltip('disable');
                } else {
                    $(this).tooltip('enable');
                }
            });
        }, 100);
    }

    function hexToRGB(hex, alpha) {
        var r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16),
            g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16),
            b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
        return "rgba(" + r + ", " + g + ", " + b + ", " + alpha + ")";
    }

    function raiseAppseeEvent(data) {
        if (!data.isNew) {
            return;
        }
        var payload = {};
        payload.name = "Guided Self-service Started";
        payload.data = {};
        payload.data["Guided Self-service"] = data.processName;
        payload.data["User Id"] = data.userId;
        payload.data["Source"] = data.source;
        snAnalytics.addEvent(payload);
    }

    c.asyncGet = function() {
        $scope.isLoading = true;
        c.data.action = "loadData";
        c.server.update().then(function(response) {
            $scope.isLoading = false;
            setTimeout(handleToolTip);
        });
    };


    var load_config = c.data.load_config;
    if (load_config === "async")

    else {
        $scope.isLoading = false;
        setTimeout(handleToolTip);
    }

              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.title}}"

              ng-class="getCustomColor('text')" 
              ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">{{item.title}}
          </span>
          <i class="fa fa-external-link external-link--icon"
             ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')"
             ng-class="getCustomColor('text')" 
             ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">
          </i>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span id="{{data.instanceId}}-ext-link-{{$index}}"
          class="sr-only"
          ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">${, opens in a new window}
      </span>
    </a>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Thumbnail Cards Default Aligned -->   
  <div ng-class="{'all-card-container-left' : (c.data.card_size === 'card-medium'),'all-card-container' : (c.data.card_size === 'card-small')}" 
       ng-if="c.data.card_type=='Thumbnail' && c.data.text_alignment=='Default'">
    <a ng-repeat="item in data.json_data" 
       class="card-thumbnail-align-left {{c.data.card_size}}"
       aria-labelledby="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-href="{{item.url}}"
       id="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-attr-target="{{item.target}}" 
       ng-class="getCustomColor('background')" 
       ng-style="getStyle(item, 'background')">
      <div class="icon-container {{c.data.card_size}}" 
           ng-if="c.data.show_icon === 'true' && [item.icon.length] != 0">
        <div class="icon-bg-color" 
             ng-class = "{'icon-bg-color--small': (c.data.card_size === 'card-small'),[getCustomColor('icon_overlay')] : true}"
             ng-if="c.data.icon_background_color === 'true' && [item.icon.length] != 0"
             ng-style="getStyle(item, 'icon_overlay')"/>
        <div class="icon"
             ng-if="[item.icon.length] != 0"
             ng-class = "{'icon--with-overlay' : (c.data.icon_background_color === 'true'),
                          'icon--small-with-overlay': (c.data.card_size === 'card-small' && c.data.icon_background_color === 'true'),
                          'icon--small': (c.data.card_size === 'card-small' && c.data.icon_background_color === 'false')}"
             style="background-image: url({{item.icon}})"/>
      </div>
      <div class="content-container">
        <div class = "title--with-icon">
          <span class='card-title text-left-align text-ellipsis'
                ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.title}}"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
                ng-class = "{[getTextEllipsisClassForIE(item)] : true,[getCustomColor('text')] : true}"
                ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">{{item.title}}
          </span>
          <i class="fa fa-external-link external-link--icon"
             ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')"
             ng-class="getCustomColor('text')" 
             ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">
          </i>
        </div>
        <span class='card-description text-left-align text-ellipsis'
              id="{{data.instanceId}}-card-desc-{{$index}}"

              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.shortDescription}}"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
              ng-class = "{[getTextEllipsisClassForIE(item)] : true, [getCustomColor('text')] : true}"
              ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')"
              ng-if="c.data.show_description === 'true' && c.data.card_size != 'card-small'" >{{item.shortDescription}}
        </span>
      </div>
      <span id="{{data.instanceId}}-ext-link-{{$index}}"
            class="sr-only"
            ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">${, opens in a new window}
      </span>
    </a>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Simple Cards (Center / Default) -->  
  <div class="all-card-container" 
       ng-if="c.data.card_type=='Simple'">
    <a ng-repeat="item in data.json_data"
       class="card-simple {{c.data.card_size}}"
       aria-labelledby="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-href="{{item.url}}"
       id="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"

           ng-class="{'content-left-align': c.data.text_alignment=='Default'}">
        <div class = "title--with-icon">
          <span class="card-title text-ellipsis"
                ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.title}}"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
                ng-class="{'text-left-align': c.data.text_alignment=='Default'}">{{item.title}}
          </span>
          <i class="fa fa-external-link external-link--icon"
             ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">
          </i>
        </div>
        <span class="card-description text-ellipsis"
              ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.shortDescription}}"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
              id="{{data.instanceId}}-card-desc-{{$index}}"
              ng-class="{'text-left-align': c.data.text_alignment=='Default'}" 
              ng-if="c.data.show_description === 'true' && c.data.card_size =='card-medium'">{{item.shortDescription}}
        </span>
      </div>
      <span id="{{data.instanceId}}-ext-link-{{$index}}"
            class="sr-only"
            ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">${, opens in a new window}
      </span>
    </a>
  </div>
</div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Data Table from Instance - Peak">c7879b5cc3dbc75051347405e4013156</child><cloned>2026-09-09 12:56:35</cloned><last_validated>2026-09-09 12:56:35</last_validated><parent display_value="Data Table from Instance Definition">38058ff1cb11020000f8d856634c9c8c</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category>standard</category><client_script><![CDATA[function ($scope, spUtil, $location, spAriaFocusManager) {
	$scope.$on('data_table.click', function(e, parms){
		var p = $scope.data.page_id || 'form';
		var s = {id: p, table: parms.table, sys_id: parms.sys_id, view: 'sp'};
		var newURL = $location.search(s);
		spAriaFocusManager.navigateToLink(newURL.url());
	});
}]]></client_script><controller_as/><css/><data_table>sp_instance_table</data_table><demo_data/><description/><docs/><field_list>table,filter,field_list,maximum_entries,order_by,order_direction,title,color,glyph,sp_page</field_list><has_preview>false</has_preview><id/><internal>false</internal><link/><name>Data Table from Instance Definition</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles>snc_external,snc_internal</roles><script><![CDATA[(function(){
	/*  "use strict"; - linter issues */
	// populate the 'data' object
	var sp_page = $sp.getValue('sp_page');
	var pageGR = new GlideRecord('sp_page');
	pageGR.get(sp_page);
	data.page_id = pageGR.getValue("id");
	$sp.getValues(data);
	if (data.field_list) {
		data.fields_array = data.field_list.split(',');
	} else {
		data.field_list = $sp.getListColumns(data.table);
	}

	if (input) {
		data.p = input.p;
		data.o = input.o;
		data.d = input.d;
		data.q = input.q;
		// additional inputs for using a spModal
		data.table = input.table;
		data.filter = input.filter;
		data.view = input.view;
	}
	data.p = data.p || 1;
	data.o = data.o || $sp.getValue('order_by');
	data.d = data.d || $sp.getValue('order_direction');

	data.page_index = (data.p - 1);
	data.window_size = $sp.getValue('maximum_entries') || 10;
	data.window_start  = (data.page_index * data.window_size);
	data.window_end = (((data.page_index + 1) * data.window_size));
	// adding data.filter here so 
	// it can be picked up from an input.filter above
	data.filter = data.filter || $sp.getValue("filter");

	var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(data.table);
	if (!gr.isValid()) {
		data.invalid_table = true;
		data.table_label = data.table;
		return;
	}
	data.table_label = gr.getLabel();

	options.table = data.table;
	options.fields = data.field_list;
	options.o=data.o;
	options.d= data.d;
	options.filter=data.filter;
	options.window_size=data.window_size;
	options.view = data.view;
	options.useInstanceTitle = true; // to make sure Data Table widget uses headerTitle always
	options.headerTitle = options.title;
	options.show_breadcrumbs=true;
	
	data.dataTableWidget = $sp.getWidget('widget-data-table', options);
})();]]></script><servicenow>true</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2015-07-17 21:37:50</sys_created_on><sys_id>38058ff1cb11020000f8d856634c9c8c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>255</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Data Table from Instance Definition</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Service Portal - Core" source="com.glide.service-portal">0490b60a18b632108bb255f46a373a3b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_38058ff1cb11020000f8d856634c9c8c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-11-15 21:43:43</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div>
  <div class="alert alert-danger" ng-if="data.invalid_table">
    ${Table not defined} '{{data.table_label}}'
  </div>
  <sp-widget ng-if="data.dataTableWidget" widget="data.dataTableWidget"></sp-widget>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></payload><sys_class_name>sp_rel_widget_clone</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-09 12:56:35</sys_created_on><sys_id>4b87d790c31fc75051347405e401319e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>c7879b5cc3dbc75051347405e4013156</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_4b87d790c31fc75051347405e401319e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 12:56:35</sys_updated_on></sp_rel_widget_clone></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_44983185c3d34f5051347405e40131b8
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2133764_peak_e_0.ContractApprovalAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ContractApprovalAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ContractApprovalAjax = Class.create();
ContractApprovalAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    approveContractState: function() {
        var contractId = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract');

        if (gr.get(contractId)) {
            gr.state = '120';
            gr.update();

            //also add the updating of the request_state here
            var reqId = gr.getValue('related_request');
            if (reqId) {
                var requestGR = new GlideRecord('sc_request');
                if (requestGR.get(reqId)) {
                    requestGR.setValue('request_state', '	in_process'); //request_state = approved, signaling the manager approved the contract and the employees can start working on the related tasks
                    requestGR.update();
                }
            }


            return 'success';
        }
        return 'error';
    },

    type: 'ContractApprovalAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-11 13:57:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>44983185c3d34f5051347405e40131b8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ContractApprovalAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_44983185c3d34f5051347405e40131b8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 10:14:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: catalog_script_client_84288c68c3930b5051347405e401313f
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:4d1fc56fc30b035051347405e4013134</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate if end_date > start_date</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    g_form.hideFieldMsg('start_date');

    var startDateStr = g_form.getValue('start_date');

    if (startDateStr == '') {
        return;
    }
    var startDate = new Date(startDateStr);
    var currentEndDate = new Date(newValue);

    if (currentEndDate.getTime() <= startDate.getTime()) {
        g_form.showFieldMsg('end_date', 'End date cannot be the same as or before the start date', 'error');
        g_form.setValue('end_date', ''); 

		return;
    }

	var catItem = g_form.getUniqueValue();
    var start = g_form.getValue('start_date');
    var end = g_form.getValue('end_date');
	console.log("catitwm ", catItem);
	console.log("start ", start);
	console.log("end ", end);

	var ga = new GlideAjax('x_2133764_peak_e_0.EquipmentAvailability');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'checkDates');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_cat_item', catItem);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_startDate', start);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_endDate', end);
    ga.getXMLAnswer(process);

	function process(answer) {
        console.log("SERVER ANSWER: ", answer);
        if (answer) {
            var periods = JSON.parse(answer);
            console.log("PARSED ARRAY LENGTH: ", periods.length);

            if (periods.length > 0) {
                // Build the custom error message
                var msg = "This equipment is rented for the following periods: \n";
                for (var i = 0; i < periods.length; i++) {
                    msg += (i + 1) + ". " + periods[i].start + " to " + periods[i].end + "\n";
                }

                // Fix 3: Clear the value FIRST, then show the message
                g_form.setValue(control.name, '');
                g_form.showFieldMsg(control.name, msg, 'error');
            }
        }
    }

	var startStr = g_form.getValue('start_date');
    var endStr = g_form.getValue('end_date');

    if (startStr != '' && endStr != '') {
        var startDateObj = new Date(startStr);
        var endDateObj = new Date(endStr);

        // Calculate the difference in milliseconds
        var diffTime = endDateObj.getTime() - startDateObj.getTime();

        // Convert milliseconds to days
        var diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

        // Failsafe: Ensure it is at least a 1-day rental if they select the next day
        if (diffDays <= 0) {
            diffDays = 1;
        }

        // Automatically update the native cart Quantity field
        //g_form.setValue('quantity', diffDays);
		g_cart.setQuantity(diffDays);
    }

    //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-09 16:28:50</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>84288c68c3930b5051347405e401313f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate if end_date > start_date</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_84288c68c3930b5051347405e401313f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 11:56:50</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Rental Details">d01e85ebc30b035051347405e401319f</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><description/><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>x_2133764_peak_e_0.redirectToUrl</name><script><![CDATA[redirectToUrl();

function redirectToUrl() {
    grUserPreference = new GlideRecord('sys_user_preference');
    grUserPreference.addQuery('user', top.window.NOW.user_id); // picking up current user as g_user doesnt work here.
    grUserPreference.addQuery('name', 'sfRedirectPortal');
    grUserPreference.query(response);

    function response(result) {
        var url = '';
        var sflastRedirect = '';
        if (result.next()) {
            url = result.value;
            sflastRedirect = localStorage.getItem("sflastRedirect");

            if (url != "" && top.window.location.toString().indexOf(url) == -1 && (grUserPreference.sys_updated_on > sflastRedirect || sflastRedirect == null)) {
                localStorage.setItem("sflastRedirect", grUserPreference.sys_updated_on);
                top.window.location = url;
            }
        }
    }
}]]></script><script_name>redirectToUrl</script_name><sys_class_name>sys_ui_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-28 11:57:56</sys_created_on><sys_id>24008de6c3634b1451347405e40131c8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_2133764_peak_e_0.redirectToUrl</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_script_24008de6c3634b1451347405e40131c8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-28 12:06:13</sys_updated_on><ui_type>10</ui_type><use_scoped_format>false</use_scoped_format></sys_ui_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Report Equipment Issue - SP">4f3505e2c3a34b1451347405e40131d6</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Parse URL parameters - SP</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onLoad() {
   //Type appropriate comment here, and begin script below
   var urlParams = new URLSearchParams(top.window.location.search);
   var contractId = urlParams.get('sysparm_contract');
    var itemId = urlParams.get('sysparm_contract_item');
    var equipId = urlParams.get('sysparm_equipment');
	var clientId = urlParams.get('sysparm_client');

	console.log(clientId);


    if (contractId) {
        g_form.setValue('contract', contractId);
    }
	if (clientId) {
        g_form.setValue('client', clientId); 
    }
    
    //slight delay to allow the system to process the Contract selection
    setTimeout(function() {
        if (itemId) {
            g_form.setValue('contract_item', itemId);
        }
        if (equipId) {
            g_form.setValue('equipment', equipId);
        }
		
    }, 500); //time for the reference qualifier to catch up
   
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-28 12:58:44</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>2eedc9a6c3e34b1451347405e4013132</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Parse URL parameters - SP</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_2eedc9a6c3e34b1451347405e4013132</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-28 12:58:44</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>false</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_rel_widget_clone"><sp_rel_widget_clone action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><child display_value="Copy of Quick Links">7c5fb093c3df8f9051347405e4013162</child><cloned>2026-09-18 09:33:17</cloned><last_validated>2026-09-18 09:33:17</last_validated><parent display_value="Quick Links">dae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be</parent><payload><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><sp_widget><category>servicenow</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($scope, $timeout, $window, snAnalytics) {
    /* widget controller */

    var c = this;
    $scope.isLoading = false;

    $scope.card_size = c.data.card_size;
    $scope.card_type = c.data.card_type;

    $scope.handleCardFocus = function(event) {
        var $target = $(event.target);
        var $titleEl = $target.find('.text-ellipsis[data-toggle="tooltip"]').first();
        if ($titleEl.length)
            $titleEl.tooltip("show");
    };

    $scope.handleCardBlur = function(event) {
        var $target = $(event.target);
        var $titleEl = $target.find('.text-ellipsis[data-toggle="tooltip"]').first();
        if ($titleEl.length)
            $titleEl.tooltip("hide");
    };

    $scope.clicked = function(item) {
        if (item.type == 'guided_help') {
            c.server.get({
                "action": "openGuidedhelp",
                "guidedHelpId": item.guided_help
            }).then(function(resp) {
                $timeout(function() {
                    $window.open(resp.data.guidedHelpResponse.url, '_self');
                }, raiseAppseeEvent(resp.data.guidedHelpResponse));
            });
        }
    };

    $scope.getCustomColor = function(styleClassFor) {
        var cssCustomClass = "";

        var supportedColors = {
            "Primary": "primary-color",
            "Dark": "dark-color",
            "Light": "light-color",
            "Accent": "accent-color",
            "Hexcode": ""
        };

        var darkColors = ['Primary', 'Dark', 'Accent'];

        switch (styleClassFor) {
            case 'background':
                cssCustomClass = (c.data.background_color) ? supportedColors[c.data.background_color] : '';
                break;
            case 'icon_overlay':
                cssCustomClass = supportedColors[c.data.icon_background_color];
                break;
            case 'text':
                if (c.data.text_color === 'false') {
                    cssCustomClass = 'text-color-black';
                    if (c.data.text_alignment === 'Default') {
                        if (darkColors.includes(c.data.background_color)) {
                            cssCustomClass = 'text-color-white';
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (c.data.show_background === 'false' && c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                            if (darkColors.includes(c.data.background_color)) {
                                cssCustomClass = 'text-color-white';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
        return cssCustomClass;
    };

    $scope.getStyle = function(item, styleRequiredFor) {
        var styleObj = {};
        switch (styleRequiredFor) {
            case 'background':
                if (c.data.show_background === 'true' && c.data.card_type === 'Thumbnail' && c.data.text_alignment === 'Center' && item.bg_image && item.bg_image.length != 0) {
                    styleObj['background-image'] = 'url(' + item.bg_image + ')';
                }
                if (c.data.background_color === 'Hexcode') {
                    styleObj['background-color'] = c.data.background_hexcode;
                }
                if (item.type == 'guided_help') {
                    styleObj['cursor'] = 'pointer';
                }
                break;
            case 'icon_overlay':
                if (c.data.icon_background_color === 'true') {
                    styleObj['background-color'] = c.data.icon_background_hexcode;
                }
                break;
            case 'text_overlay':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'true') {
                    styleObj['background-color'] = hexToRGB(c.data.text_overlay_hexcode, '0.7');
                }
                break;
            case 'text':
                if (c.data.text_color === 'true') {
                    styleObj['color'] = c.data.text_color_hexcode;
                }
                break;
        }
        return styleObj;
    };

    $scope.getEvaluatedIconContainer = function(item) {
        switch (c.data.card_size) {
            case 'card-small':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                    return 'icon-container--no-image-color';
                } else {
                    return 'icon-container--background-small';
                }
                break;
            case 'card-medium':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                    if ((c.data.show_icon === 'true' && item.icon.length == 0) || c.data.show_icon === 'false') {
                        return 'icon-container--no-image-color';
                    } else {
                        return 'icon-container--background-medium';
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
    }

    $scope.getEvaluatedContentContainer = function(item) {
        switch (c.data.card_size) {
            case 'card-small':
                return 'content-container--no-image-color';
            case 'card-medium':
                if (c.data.show_text_overlay === 'false') {
                    if (c.data.show_icon === 'true' && item.icon.length != 0) {
                        return 'content-container--content-start';
                    } else {
                        return 'content-container--no-image-color';
                    }
                }
                break;
        }
    };

    $scope.getTextEllipsisClassForIE = function(item) {
        var cssClassName = "text-ellipsis-";
        if (c.data.card_size === 'card-medium') {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "medium";
        } else {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "small";
        }
        if (c.data.show_icon === 'true' && item.icon && item.icon.length != 0) {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "-icon";
        } else {
            cssClassName = cssClassName + "-no-icon";
        }
        return cssClassName;
    };

    $(window).resize(handleToolTip);
    $scope.$evalAsync(handleToolTip);

    function handleToolTip() {
        var isIE = window.navigator.userAgent.indexOf('Trident/') !== -1;
        $timeout(function() {
            $(".card-thumbnail-align-center, .card-thumbnail-align-left, .card-simple").each(function(index) {
                var hideToolTip = false;
                var span = $(this).find(".card-title");
                if (isIE) {
                    if (span && span[0] && span.width() >= span[0].scrollWidth) {
                        hideToolTip = true;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (span && span[0] && span.height() >= span[0].scrollHeight) {
                        hideToolTip = true;
                    }
                }
                if (hideToolTip) {
                    $(this).tooltip('disable');
                } else {
                    $(this).tooltip('enable');
                }
            });
        }, 100);
    }

    function hexToRGB(hex, alpha) {
        var r = parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16),
            g = parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16),
            b = parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16);
        return "rgba(" + r + ", " + g + ", " + b + ", " + alpha + ")";
    }

    function raiseAppseeEvent(data) {
        if (!data.isNew) {
            return;
        }
        var payload = {};
        payload.name = "Guided Self-service Started";
        payload.data = {};
        payload.data["Guided Self-service"] = data.processName;
        payload.data["User Id"] = data.userId;
        payload.data["Source"] = data.source;
        snAnalytics.addEvent(payload);
    }

    c.asyncGet = function() {
        $scope.isLoading = true;
        c.data.action = "loadData";
        c.server.update().then(function(response) {
            $scope.isLoading = false;
            setTimeout(handleToolTip);
        });
    };


    var load_config = c.data.load_config;
    if (load_config === "async")
        setTimeout(c.asyncGet);
    else {
        $scope.isLoading = false;
        setTimeout(handleToolTip);
    }
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>$background-primary: #FFFFFF !default;

	border-radius: $border-radius-base;
	background-size: 100% 100%;
	background-position: bottom;
	word-break: break-word;
	word-wrap: break-word;
	overflow: hidden;
	.icon-container {
		padding: $rm * 4 $rm * 8 $rm * 4;
		min-height: 92px;
	}
	.icon-container--no-image-color {
		min-height: 0;
		padding: 0;
	}
	.icon-container--background-medium {
		min-height: 92px;
	}
	.icon-container--background-small {
		min-height: 44px;
	}
	.content-container--no-image-color {
		justify-content: center;
		padding: 0 $rm * 4;
		background-color: transparent;
	}
}

.card-thumbnail-align-center.card-medium {
	max-height: 155px;
	min-height: 140px;
}

.card-thumbnail-align-center.card-small {
	max-height: 108px;
	min-height: 76px;
}

.icon-container {
	position: relative;
	box-sizing: border-box;
	display: flex;
	flex-grow: 0;
	flex-shrink: 1;
	justify-content: center;
	align-items: center;
}

.icon {
	width: 64px;
	height: 64px;
	background-size: cover;
	z-index: 2;
	position: absolute;
}
.icon--with-overlay {
	height: 48px;
	width: 48px;
}

.icon--small {
	width: 42px;
	height: 42px;
}

.icon--small-with-overlay {
	width: 30px;
	height: 30px;
}

.icon-bg-color {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	z-index: 1;
	width: 76px;
	height: 76px;
	opacity: 0.7;
	border-radius: 50%;
	mix-blend-mode: normal;
	position: absolute;
}

.icon-bg-color--small {
	width: 48px;
	height: 48px;
}

.content-container {
	box-sizing: border-box;
	display: flex;
	bottom: 0;
	flex-grow: 1;
	align-items: center;
	padding: $rm * 4 $rm * 8 $rm * 4;
	flex-direction: column;
	background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
	mix-blend-mode: normal;
}

.card-thumbnail-align-center:hover,
.card-thumbnail-align-left:hover {
	box-shadow: $sp-panel-box-shadow;
}

.card-title {
	text-align: center;
	font-style: normal;
	font-weight: $headings-font-weight;
	color: $text-primary;
	font-size: $rm * 8;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
}

.card-description {
	text-align: center;
	font-style: normal;
	font-weight: normal;
	color: $text-primary;
	font-size: $rm * 7;
	padding-top: $rm * 2;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
}

.text-ellipsis {
	word-wrap: break-word;
	overflow: hidden;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
	display: -webkit-box;
	-webkit-box-orient: vertical;
	-webkit-line-clamp: 2;
}

a:hover {
	text-decoration: none !important;
}

.all-card-container {
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(20rem, 1fr));
}

.all-card-container-left {
	grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(25rem, 1fr));
}

@media screen and (-ms-high-contrast: active),
(-ms-high-contrast: none) {
	.all-card-container,
	.all-card-container-left {
		display: flex;
		flex-wrap: wrap;
		justify-content: space-around;
	}
	
	.card-thumbnail-align-left.card-medium {
		width: 250px;
		min-width: 250px;
		max-width: 250px;
		margin-bottom: 16px;
		margin-right: 16px;
		flex: 1 0 100%;
	}

	.card-thumbnail-align-left.card-small,
	.card-thumbnail-align-center,
	.card-simple {
		width: 200px;
		min-width: 200px;
		max-width: 200px;
		margin-bottom: 16px;
		margin-right: 16px;
		flex: 1 0 100%;
	}

	.text-ellipsis {
		width: 160px;
	}

	.text-ellipsis-small-icon {
		width: 90px;
	}
  
	.text-ellipsis-small-no-icon {
		width: 140px;
	}
  
	.text-ellipsis-medium-icon {
		width: 100px;
	}

	.text-ellipsis-medium-no-icon {
		width: 180px;
	}
  
	.icon,
	.icon-bg-color {
		top: 50%;
		left: 50%;
		transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
	}

    controller.keyboardAction = function(event,item) {
        if (event.keyCode == 13 || event.keyCode == 32) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            if (item.type == 'guided_help') {
                scope.clicked(item);
                return;
            }
            event.target.click();
        }
    };
}]]></link><name>Quick Links</name><option_schema>[{"hint":"","name":"title","section":"Presentation","default_value":"Quick links","label":"Title","type":"string"},{"hint":"The display style of the state","type":"boolean"}]</option_schema><public>true</public><roles>snc_internal,sn_ta_hiring_core.applicant,snc_external</roles><script><![CDATA[(function() {
    data.load_config = options.load_config;
    if (data.load_config === "async" && !input)
        return;
    data.quickLinkHeader = gs.getMessage(options.title);
    data.instanceId = $sp.getDisplayValue("sys_id");
    var quickLinkId = $sp.getParameter("quick_link_id");
    var pageId = $sp.getParameter("id");
    var startTime = new GlideDateTime();

    data.portal = $sp.getPortalRecord();
    var quickLinkUtil = new sn_ex_sp.QuickLinkUtil();

    setOptions(options);
    if (quickLinkId && pageId == "quick_link_preview") {
        data.json_data = quickLinkUtil.fetchQuicklinksForHomePage(quickLinkId, data.instanceId);
    } else if (options.quick_links) {
        data.json_data = quickLinkUtil.fetchQuicklinksForHomePage(options.quick_links, data.instanceId);
    }

    var stats = {};
    stats.callerId = data.instanceId;
    stats.textPrefix = 'Quick Links';
    stats.startTime = startTime;
    stats.shortDesc = 'Load Data';
    new sn_ex_sp.PerformanceIndicatorUtil().postInstanceHotspot(stats);

    function setOptions(customOptions) {
        var cardSizes = {
            "Small": "card-small",
            "Medium": "card-medium"
        };

        data.card_type = customOptions.card_type;
        data.card_size = cardSizes[customOptions.card_size];
        data.text_alignment = customOptions.text_alignment === "Center" ? customOptions.text_alignment : "Default";

        data.show_background = customOptions.show_background;
        data.show_icon = customOptions.show_icon;
        data.show_description = customOptions.show_description;

        data.background_color = customOptions.background_color;
        data.background_hexcode = customOptions.background_hexcode;

        data.icon_background_color = customOptions.icon_background_color;
        data.icon_background_hexcode = customOptions.icon_background_hexcode;

        data.show_text_overlay = customOptions.show_text_overlay;
        data.text_overlay_hexcode = customOptions.text_overlay_hexcode;

        data.text_color = customOptions.text_color;
        data.text_color_hexcode = customOptions.text_color_hexcode;
        data.showEmptyState = options.show_empty_state;
    }

    if (input && input.action == 'openGuidedhelp' && input.guidedHelpId) {
        data.pageId = $sp.getParameter('id') ? $sp.getParameter('id') : data.portal.homepage.getDisplayValue();
        data.guidedHelpResponse = new sn_ex_sp.QuickLinkUtil().handleGuidedHelpClick(input.guidedHelpId, data.pageId, "quick_link");
    }

})();]]></script><servicenow>true</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2021-05-17 09:46:28</sys_created_on><sys_id>dae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1761</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Quick Links</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Employee Center" source="sn_ex_sp">4249e63a28d54d61bb6fbf61fd86cccb</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Employee Center">4249e63a28d54d61bb6fbf61fd86cccb</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_dae53627530030101865ddeeff7b12be</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-02-18 11:53:15</sys_updated_on><template><![CDATA[<div class = "link-container panel panel-default b panel-wrapper" 
     ng-if="(data.json_data && data.json_data.length > 0) || data.showEmptyState === 'true'">
  <div class = "panel-heading b-b">
    	 <h3 class="panel-title" id="{{data.instanceId}}-widget-title">{{data.quickLinkHeader}}</h3>
  </div>  
 <div class="quick-link-empty-state" ng-if="data.showEmptyState === 'true' && (!data.json_data || data.json_data.length === 0)">
  <p>${We don't have any quick links to show you yet.}</p>
 </div>
 <div ng-if="data.json_data && data.json_data.length > 0" aria-labelledby="{{data.instanceId}}-widget-title" role="region">
  <!-- Thumbnail Cards Center Aligned --> 
  <div class="all-card-container" 
       ng-if="c.data.card_type == 'Thumbnail' && c.data.text_alignment == 'Center'">
    <a ng-repeat="item in data.json_data" 
       class="card-thumbnail-align-center {{c.data.card_size}}"
       aria-labelledby="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       id="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-href="{{item.url}}"
       ng-click="clicked(item)"
       ng-attr-target="{{item.target}}"
       ng-class="getCustomColor('background')" 
       ng-style="getStyle(item, 'background')"
       ng-keydown="c.keyboardAction($event,item)"
       ng-focus="handleCardFocus($event)"
       ng-blur="handleCardBlur($event)"
       tabindex="0">
      <div class="icon-container" 
           ng-class = "getEvaluatedIconContainer(item)">
        <div class="icon-bg-color" 
             ng-if="(c.data.icon_background_color === 'true' && c.data.show_icon === 'true' && c.data.card_size != 'card-small' && [item.icon.length] != 0)"
             ng-class="getCustomColor('icon_overlay')" 
             ng-style="getStyle(item,'icon_overlay')"/>
        <div class = "icon"
             ng-class="{'icon--with-overlay' : (c.data.icon_background_color === 'true')}"
             ng-if="[item.icon.length] != 0 && c.data.show_icon === 'true' && c.data.card_size != 'card-small'" 
             style="background-image: url({{item.icon}})"/>
      </div>
      <div class="content-container" 
           ng-class = "getEvaluatedContentContainer(item)"
           ng-style="getStyle(item,'text_overlay')">
        <div class = "title--with-icon">
          <span class="card-title text-ellipsis"
              ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.title}}"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
              ng-class="getCustomColor('text')" 
              ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">{{item.title}}
          </span>
          <i class="fa fa-external-link external-link--icon"
             ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')"
             ng-class="getCustomColor('text')" 
             ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">
          </i>
        </div>
      </div>
      <span id="{{data.instanceId}}-ext-link-{{$index}}"
          class="sr-only"
          ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">${, opens in a new window}
      </span>
    </a>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Thumbnail Cards Default Aligned -->   
  <div ng-class="{'all-card-container-left' : (c.data.card_size === 'card-medium'),'all-card-container' : (c.data.card_size === 'card-small')}" 
       ng-if="c.data.card_type=='Thumbnail' && c.data.text_alignment=='Default'">
    <a ng-repeat="item in data.json_data" 
       class="card-thumbnail-align-left {{c.data.card_size}}"
       aria-labelledby="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-href="{{item.url}}"
       id="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-attr-target="{{item.target}}" 
       ng-class="getCustomColor('background')" 
       ng-style="getStyle(item, 'background')">
      <div class="icon-container {{c.data.card_size}}" 
           ng-if="c.data.show_icon === 'true' && [item.icon.length] != 0">
        <div class="icon-bg-color" 
             ng-class = "{'icon-bg-color--small': (c.data.card_size === 'card-small'),[getCustomColor('icon_overlay')] : true}"
             ng-if="c.data.icon_background_color === 'true' && [item.icon.length] != 0"
             ng-style="getStyle(item, 'icon_overlay')"/>
        <div class="icon"
             ng-if="[item.icon.length] != 0"
             ng-class = "{'icon--with-overlay' : (c.data.icon_background_color === 'true'),
                          'icon--small-with-overlay': (c.data.card_size === 'card-small' && c.data.icon_background_color === 'true'),
                          'icon--small': (c.data.card_size === 'card-small' && c.data.icon_background_color === 'false')}"
             style="background-image: url({{item.icon}})"/>
      </div>
      <div class="content-container">
        <div class = "title--with-icon">
          <span class='card-title text-left-align text-ellipsis'
                ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.title}}"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
                ng-class = "{[getTextEllipsisClassForIE(item)] : true,[getCustomColor('text')] : true}"
                ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">{{item.title}}
          </span>
          <i class="fa fa-external-link external-link--icon"
             ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')"
             ng-class="getCustomColor('text')" 
             ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')">
          </i>
        </div>
        <span class='card-description text-left-align text-ellipsis'
              id="{{data.instanceId}}-card-desc-{{$index}}"
              ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.shortDescription}}"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
              ng-class = "{[getTextEllipsisClassForIE(item)] : true, [getCustomColor('text')] : true}"
              ng-style="getStyle(item,'text')"
              ng-if="c.data.show_description === 'true' && c.data.card_size != 'card-small'" >{{item.shortDescription}}
        </span>
      </div>
      <span id="{{data.instanceId}}-ext-link-{{$index}}"
            class="sr-only"
            ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">${, opens in a new window}
      </span>
    </a>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Simple Cards (Center / Default) -->  
  <div class="all-card-container" 
       ng-if="c.data.card_type=='Simple'">
    <a ng-repeat="item in data.json_data"
       class="card-simple {{c.data.card_size}}"
       aria-labelledby="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-href="{{item.url}}"
       id="{{data.instanceId}}-item-{{$index}}"
       ng-attr-target="{{item.target}}">
      <div class="content-container" 
           ng-class="{'content-left-align': c.data.text_alignment=='Default'}">
        <div class = "title--with-icon">
          <span class="card-title text-ellipsis"
                ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.title}}"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
                ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
                ng-class="{'text-left-align': c.data.text_alignment=='Default'}">{{item.title}}
          </span>
          <i class="fa fa-external-link external-link--icon"
             ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">
          </i>
        </div>
        <span class="card-description text-ellipsis"
              ec-multiline-ellipsis-tooltip
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-title="{{item.shortDescription}}"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-toggle="tooltip"
              ec-ellipsis-tooltip-data-container="body"
              id="{{data.instanceId}}-card-desc-{{$index}}"
              ng-class="{'text-left-align': c.data.text_alignment=='Default'}" 
              ng-if="c.data.show_description === 'true' && c.data.card_size =='card-medium'">{{item.shortDescription}}
        </span>
      </div>
      <span id="{{data.instanceId}}-ext-link-{{$index}}"
            class="sr-only"
            ng-if="(item.target == '_blank')">${, opens in a new window}
      </span>
    </a>
  </div>
</div>
</div>]]></template></sp_widget></payload><sys_class_name>sp_rel_widget_clone</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-18 09:33:17</sys_created_on><sys_id>785f3493c3df8f9051347405e401310d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>7c5fb093c3df8f9051347405e4013162</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_rel_widget_clone_785f3493c3df8f9051347405e401310d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-18 09:33:17</sys_updated_on></sp_rel_widget_clone></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_6ca4e8fcc3978b5051347405e40131a1
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2133764_peak_e_0.ContractSignatureAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ContractSignatureAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ContractSignatureAjax = Class.create();
ContractSignatureAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    saveSignature: function() {
        var contractId = this.getParameter('sysparm_sys_id');
        var base64Data = this.getParameter('sysparm_base64');

        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract');
        if (gr.get(contractId)) {
            var attachment = new GlideSysAttachment();
            var fileName = 'Client_Signature.png';

            //find and delete any existing signatures on this specific contract
            var attGr = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
            attGr.addQuery('table_name', gr.getTableName());
            attGr.addQuery('table_sys_id', gr.getUniqueValue());
            attGr.addQuery('file_name', fileName);
            attGr.query();

            while (attGr.next()) {
                attachment.deleteAttachment(attGr.getUniqueValue());
            }
            // writeBase64 securely saves the image as a standard ServiceNow attachment
            attachment.writeBase64(gr, fileName, 'image/png', base64Data);

            //modify state of the contract
            gr.state = '110'; // pending approval
            gr.update();

			//also add the updating of the request_state here 
			var reqId = gr.getValue('related_request');
			if(reqId){
				var requestGR = new GlideRecord('sc_request');
				if(requestGR.get(reqId)) {
				requestGR.setValue('request_state', 'requested'); //request_state = waiting for approval when the client attaches the signature, signaling to the manager that the contract can be approved
                    requestGR.update();

sys_update_xml.name: catalog_script_client_b98440e0c3930b5051347405e40131c7
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>set</applies_to><cat_item/><cat_variable>IO:793e89ebc30b035051347405e4013141</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate if start_date < end_date</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    //alert("The script is alive! Field changed to: " + newValue);

    g_form.hideFieldMsg('start_date');

    var endDateStr = g_form.getValue('end_date');

    if (endDateStr == '') {
        return;
    }
    var end_date = new Date(endDateStr);
    var currentStartDate = new Date(newValue);

    if (currentStartDate.getTime() >= end_date.getTime()) {
        g_form.setValue('start_date', '');
        g_form.showFieldMsg('start_date', 'Start date cannot be the same as or after the end date', 'error');

        return;
    }

    //run the server check if we have all three pieces of data
    var catItem = g_form.getUniqueValue();
    var start = g_form.getValue('start_date');
    var end = g_form.getValue('end_date');
    console.log("catitwm ", catItem);
    console.log("start ", start);
    console.log("end ", end);

    var ga = new GlideAjax('x_2133764_peak_e_0.EquipmentAvailability');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'checkDates');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_cat_item', catItem);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_startDate', start);
    ga.addParam('sysparm_endDate', end);
    ga.getXMLAnswer(process);

    function process(answer) {
        console.log("SERVER ANSWER: ", answer);
        if (answer) {
            var periods = JSON.parse(answer);
            console.log("PARSED ARRAY LENGTH: ", periods.length);

            if (periods.length > 0) {
                // Build the custom error message
                var msg = "This equipment is rented for the following periods: \n";
                for (var i = 0; i < periods.length; i++) {
                    msg += (i + 1) + ". " + periods[i].start + " to " + periods[i].end + "\n";
                }

                // Fix 3: Clear the value FIRST, then show the message
                g_form.setValue(control.name, '');
                g_form.showFieldMsg(control.name, msg, 'error');
            }
        }
    }


    var startStr = g_form.getValue('start_date');
    var endStr = g_form.getValue('end_date');

    if (startStr != '' && endStr != '') {
        var startDateObj = new Date(startStr);
        var endDateObj = new Date(endStr);

        // Calculate the difference in milliseconds
        var diffTime = endDateObj.getTime() - startDateObj.getTime();

        // Convert milliseconds to days
        var diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

        // Failsafe: Ensure it is at least a 1-day rental if they select the next day
        if (diffDays <= 0) {
            diffDays = 1;
        }

        // Automatically update the native cart Quantity field
        //g_form.setValue('quantity', diffDays);
		g_cart.setQuantity(diffDays);
    }


}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-09 16:21:38</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b98440e0c3930b5051347405e40131c7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>22</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate if start_date < end_date</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_b98440e0c3930b5051347405e40131c7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 11:27:47</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set display_value="Rental Details">d01e85ebc30b035051347405e401319f</variable_set><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_page"><sys_ui_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>general</category><client_script><![CDATA[var requiredTime = 15;
var currentTime = 0;
var timerInterval = null;

function initTimer() {
    var target = document.getElementById('readTarget');
    var display = document.getElementById('timerDisplay');
    var btn = document.getElementById('approveBtn');
    var contractInput = document.getElementById('contract_sys_id');

    if (!target || !display || !btn || !contractInput) {
        console.warn("HTML elements not loaded yet :(((((");
        return;
    }

    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
            if (!timerInterval && currentTime < requiredTime) {
                timerInterval = setInterval(function() {
                    currentTime++;
                    display.innerText = 'Reading... ' + currentTime + 's / ' + requiredTime + 's';
                    
                    if (currentTime >= requiredTime) {
                        clearInterval(timerInterval);
                        btn.disabled = false;
                        display.innerText = 'Approval Unlocked';
                        display.style.color = '#5cb85c';
                    }
                }, 1000);
            }
        } else {
            //user scrolled away -> Pause timer
            if (timerInterval && currentTime < requiredTime) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
        }
    }, { threshold: 0.1 });

    observer.observe(target);
}

setTimeout(initTimer, 200);

function approveContract() {
    var btn = document.getElementById('approveBtn');
    var contractInput = document.getElementById('contract_sys_id');
    
    if (!contractInput) return;
    
    var contractId = contractInput.value;

    btn.innerText = "Approving...";
    btn.disabled = true;

    var ga = new GlideAjax('ContractApprovalAjax');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'approveContractState');
    ga.addParam('sysparm_sys_id', contractId);
    
    ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {
        if(answer == 'success') {
            alert('Contract Approved successfully!');
            
            if (typeof GlideModal != 'undefined') {
                GlideModal.get().destroy();
                g_form.save(); // or location.reload(); ?
            }
        } else {
            alert('Failed to approve contract.');
            btn.innerText = "Approve Contract";
            btn.disabled = false;
        }
    });
}]]></client_script><description/><direct>false</direct><endpoint>x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract_approval_viewer.do</endpoint><html><?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null">

    <g:evaluate var="jvar_contract_id">
        RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_sys_id');
    </g:evaluate>

    <g:evaluate var="jvar_html_content">
    <![CDATA[
        var sysId = RP.getParameterValue('sysparm_sys_id');
        var current = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract');
        current.get(sysId);

        // signature from sys_attachment
        var attGr = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        attGr.addQuery('table_sys_id', sysId);
        attGr.addQuery('file_name', 'Client_Signature.png');
        attGr.query();
        
        var imgTag = '';
        if (attGr.next()) {
            imgTag = '<img src="sys_attachment.do?sys_id=' + attGr.getUniqueValue() + '" alt="Generated Image" width="200" />';
        } else {
            imgTag = '<p><i>[No signature attached yet]</i></p>';
        }

        // contract fields mapped
        var clientName = current.client.name.getDisplayValue() || 'N/A';
        var clientEmail = current.client.email.getDisplayValue() || 'N/A';
        var startDate = current.getDisplayValue('start_date') || 'N/A';
        var endDate = current.getDisplayValue('end_date') || 'N/A';
        var totalCost = current.getDisplayValue('total_equipment_cost') || '0.00';
        var updateDate = current.getDisplayValue('sys_updated_on') || new GlideDate().getDisplayValue();

        // equipments taken from the contract_item table
        var equipmentRowsHtml = '';
        var itemGr = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_contract_item');
        itemGr.addQuery('contract', sysId); 
        itemGr.query();

        while (itemGr.next()) {
            var eqName = itemGr.getDisplayValue('equipment') || 'N/A';
            var eqDesc = itemGr.getDisplayValue('equipment.description') || 'N/A';
            var eqPrice = itemGr.getDisplayValue('equipment.locked_daily_rate') || '0.00';
            
            equipmentRowsHtml += '<tr>';
            equipmentRowsHtml += '<td>' + eqName + '</td>';
            equipmentRowsHtml += '<td>' + eqDesc + '</td>';
            equipmentRowsHtml += '<td>$' + eqPrice + '</td>';
            equipmentRowsHtml += '</tr>';
        }

        if (equipmentRowsHtml === '') {
            equipmentRowsHtml = '<tr><td colspan="3">No equipment assigned.</td></tr>';
        }

        var html = '<div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; padding: 20px;">' +
            '<h2 style="text-align: center;">Rental Agreement - Number: ' + current.getValue('number') + '</h2>' +
            '<p>This Rental Agreement outlines the terms and conditions under which the Equipment Owner agrees to rent specified equipment to the Renter. This document includes responsibilities regarding care, liability, duration, and return of the rented equipment.</p>' +
            '<h3>1. Parties Involved</h3>' +
            '<p><strong>Owner:</strong> Peak Equipment</p>' +
            '<p><strong>Renter:</strong> ' + clientName + ' &#160;&#160; <strong>Email:</strong> ' + clientEmail + ' &#160;&#160; ' + '</p>' +
            '<h3>2. Equipment Description</h3>' +
            '<table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;" border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5">' +
            '<thead style="background-color: #f0f0f0;"><tr><th style="text-align: left;">Item</th><th style="text-align: left;">Description</th><th style="text-align: left;">Rental Rate</th></tr></thead>' +
            '<tbody>' + equipmentRowsHtml + '</tbody></table>' +
            '<h3>3. Rental Term</h3>' +
            '<p>The rental period will begin on <strong>' + startDate + '</strong> and end on <strong>' + endDate + '</strong>, unless otherwise agreed in writing.</p>' +
            '<h3>4. Payment Terms</h3>' +
            '<p>The total rental fee for the agreed rental period is: <strong>$' + totalCost + '</strong>.</p>' +
            '<h3>5. Deposit &amp; Insurance</h3>' +
            '<p>The Renter confirms liability terms and accepts responsibility for the equipment during the rental period. Standard deposit and insurance rules apply per peak rental policy.</p>' +
            '<h3>6. Responsibilities and Return</h3>' +
            '<p>The Renter agrees to use the equipment in a careful and proper manner. All equipment must be returned on or before <strong>' + endDate + '</strong> in good working condition. Late returns may incur additional fees.</p>' +
            '<h3>7. Signatures</h3>' +
            '<p>This document constitutes a legal and binding agreement between the parties listed above.</p>' +
            '<div style="margin-top: 30px;">' +
            '<p><strong>Renter Signature:</strong></p>' +
            imgTag +
            '<p>' + clientName + '<br/>Date: ' + updateDate + '</p>' +
            '</div></div>';

        html; 
    ]]>
    </g:evaluate>

    <!-- the visual container -->
    
    <!-- contract sys_id -->
    <input type="hidden" id="contract_sys_id" value="${jvar_contract_id}" />

    <div style="height: 550px; overflow-y: auto; background-color: white; border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);">
        
        <!-- HTML of the agreement -->
        <g:no_escape>${jvar_html_content}</g:no_escape>

        <!-- IntersectionObserver Target -->
        <div id="readTarget" style="height: 50px; margin-top: 40px; border-top: 2px dashed #ddd; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #888;">
            <i>--- End of Document (Keep this in view to approve) ---</i>
        </div>

    </div>

    <!-- timer and button to approve -->
    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 15px; background-color: #f5f5f5; border-top: 1px solid #ddd;">
        
        <!-- timer -->
        <div id="timerDisplay" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #d9534f;">
            Scroll to the bottom to start reading timer...
        </div>
        
        <!-- button with onClick function to approve the contract -> changing the state to 'approved' -->
        <div>
            <button id="approveBtn" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" disabled="disabled" onclick="approveContract();">
                Approve Contract
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

</j:jelly></html><name>contract_approval_viewer</name><processing_script/><sys_class_name>sys_ui_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-11 13:47:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>aa463541c3d34f5051347405e40131b1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>contract_approval_viewer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_page_aa463541c3d34f5051347405e40131b1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 17:11:46</sys_updated_on></sys_ui_page></record_update>

restrictedtrueon_desktopfalsecb330127c3c7035051347405e401313501970-01-03 00:00:00Complete your lift work safely with a pipe cradle rental. Pipe cradles mount above the railings of a scissor lift to store piping and conduits off the platform. Take advantage of more space on the lift and avoid trip hazards and strain from constantly bending and lifting. Add this pipe cradle accessory to your lift rental and set your site up for success.
Secure pipes and conduits off the scissor lift platform
Increase working space
Keep equipment within reach with no bending or tripping
Best for plumbing and electrical work

Rental Agreement - Number: ${number}

This Rental Agreement outlines the terms and conditions under which the Equipment Owner agrees to rent specified equipment to the Renter. This document includes responsibilities regarding care, liability, duration, and return of the rented equipment.

1. Parties Involved

Owner: Peak Equipment

Renter: ${client.name}     Email: ${client.email}     Phone: ${client.phone}

2. Equipment Description

[[equipment_list]]
Item Description Rental Rate

3. Rental Term

The rental period will begin on ${start_date} and end on ${end_date}, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

4. Payment Terms

The total rental fee for the agreed rental period is: insert total cost here.

5. Deposit & Insurance

The Renter confirms liability terms and accepts responsibility for the equipment during the rental period. Standard deposit and insurance rules apply per peak rental policy.

6. Responsibilities and Return

The Renter agrees to use the equipment in a careful and proper manner. All equipment must be returned on or before ${end_date} in good working condition. Late returns may incur additional fees.

7. Signatures

This document constitutes a legal and binding agreement between the parties listed above.

Renter Signature:

insert nume here
Date: ${sys_updated_on}

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_2133764_peak_e_0.EquipmentAccessories</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>EquipmentAccessories</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var EquipmentAccessories = Class.create();
EquipmentAccessories.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    
    checkForCompatibleAccessories: function() {
        var catItemId = this.getParameter('sysparm_cat_id');
        return this._getAcc(catItemId);
    },

    getRefQual: function(catItemId) {
        var acc = this._getAcc(catItemId);
        if (acc !== 'NONE') {
            return 'sys_idIN' + acc;
        }
        return 'sys_id=-1'; 
    },

    _getAcc: function(catItemId) {
        var catItem = new GlideRecord('sc_cat_item');
        if (catItem.get(catItemId)) {
            var eq = new GlideRecord('x_2133764_peak_e_0_equipment');
            if (eq.get('name', catItem.getValue('name'))) { 
                var acc = eq.getValue('compatible_accessories'); 
                if (acc) {
                    return acc;
                }
            }
        }
        return 'NONE';
    },

    type: 'EquipmentAccessories'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-06 21:00:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>d7a369ebc3cb035051347405e40131cf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>EquipmentAccessories</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Peak Equipment Rental" source="x_2133764_peak_e_0">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Peak Equipment Rental">50078854c30f471051347405e4013171</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d7a369ebc3cb035051347405e40131cf</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-29 17:13:46</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
